title: Automated OT-2 SARS-CoV-2 RT-PCR diagnostic workflow (inactivation, lysis, RNA extraction, plate setup, RT-qPCR)
goal: Process patient samples for SARS-CoV-2 RT-PCR at high throughput with a traceable, automated workflow on OT-2 robots and QuantStudio 5 thermocyclers, and assess throughput and turnaround time.
unresolved_refs: Reagent identities, volumes, lysis mixture, RNA extraction chemistry, and RT-PCR primers/cycling conditions are not given in the paper
